findings.evidence: AlgebraicClosed.lean:79-80 (theorem) and :86 `have := isAlgClosed_quadraticAlgebra (R := R)`; Complexification.lean:34 already uses `scoped instance` for the `Fact`; Mathlib states the analogous facts as instances (`Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/Polynomial/Basic.lean:52 instance isAlgClosed : IsAlgClosed ℂ`, `Mathlib/FieldTheory/IsAlgClosed/AlgebraicClosure.lean:203`).
findings.fix: Declare it as `scoped instance isAlgClosed_quadraticAlgebra : IsAlgClosed (QuadraticAlgebra R (-1) 0)` in `TauCeti.RealClosure`, next to the existing scoped `Fact (¬ IsSquare (-1 : R))` instance, so `open scoped TauCeti.RealClosure` supplies the field and the algebraic-closedness instance together; drop the `have :=` at line 86.
findings.issue: `isAlgClosed_quadraticAlgebra : IsAlgClosed (QuadraticAlgebra R (-1) 0)` is a plain theorem, but `IsAlgClosed` is a class. Typeclass inference therefore cannot use the headline result of this file: every consumer must write `have := isAlgClosed_quadraticAlgebra`, as line 86 of this very file does, before any `IsAlgClosed` API (`IsAlgClosed.splits_codomain`, `roots`, `exists_aeval_eq_zero`, …) applies to R[i].

findings.evidence: `grep -n 'PolynomialRolle' TauCeti` matches only `TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial/Rolle.lean` and `TauCeti/FieldTheory/RealClosure/AbstractRolle.lean`; AbstractRolle.lean:136-151 derives each direct form as a one-line application of the corresponding `PolynomialRolle.*` lemma. Roadmap Layer 1 (`RealAlgebraicGeometry/README.md:193-194`) states the Rolle target over real closed fields only.
findings.fix: Keep the direct `[IsRealClosed R]` statements as canonical and drop the `PolynomialRolle` predicate, proving mean value and the four monotonicity results directly in `AbstractRolle.lean`. (This does not conflict with the earlier round's request for direct `Polynomial` statements — it is the same direction, removing only the redundant second copy.) If the predicate is genuinely wanted for a future non-real-closed model, name that consumer and stop re-exporting all six consequences.
findings.issue: Six facts are exported twice under two public names each: `PolynomialRolle.{exists_derivative_root, exists_eval_sub_eq_derivative_eval_mul, monotoneOn, antitoneOn, strictMonoOn, strictAntiOn}` (Rolle.lean:43,51,76,85,94,101) and `Polynomial.{exists_derivative_root, exists_eval_sub_eq_derivative_eval_mul, monotoneOn_of_derivative_nonneg, antitoneOn_of_derivative_nonpos, strictMonoOn_of_derivative_pos, strictAntiOn_of_derivative_neg}` (AbstractRolle.lean:123-151). The `PolynomialRolle` predicate has exactly one supplier in the repository (`polynomialRolle_of_isRealClosed`, AbstractRolle.lean:115) and no consumer outside AbstractRolle, so the hypothesis layer is a pure intermediary that doubles the surface a user must choose between.

summary: Algebraic closedness of R[i] is a class-valued fact exposed as a plain theorem, so instance search never finds it. The Rolle development also ships two complete public surfaces for the same six facts: the `PolynomialRolle` hypothesis layer and the direct `Polynomial.*` layer under `IsRealClosed`.
